description: Enrich a company — return its full profile (headcount, industry, revenue, tech stack, funding, social links, HQ phone). Provide at least one identifier: company_website (most accurate), company_linkedin_url, company_name, or company_id (from a prior search result). Credits: 1 per successful match. No charge if no match is found. Check free_enrichment in the response to confirm whether credits were deducted.
